hardware: AlmaLinux 8.10, 2× Xeon E5-2650 v2, 32 logical CPUs, 125 GiB RAM
notes: Claviron 0.2.3 with one Deno isolate and 16 fixed PHP instances per worker. Each path used a fresh master and 16 workers.
method: GET JSON; fresh master and 16 workers per path; all five runtimes and both native modules loaded in each worker
preflight: 16 listeners and 16 OPcache warmup completions; 65,536 untimed requests on the selected path covering all workers; GET preflight for all five runtimes and each selected native module
memory_metric: RSS before/after each case; all five runtimes included; worker mode sums master and workers and counts shared pages per process
cpu_metric: Cumulative process CPU-time delta divided by wall time; 100 percent equals one fully used CPU core
